ad_name: Traya Health - Hair Diagnosis Campaign Ad

hook_audit.hook_critique: The mobile website interface is visible immediately, which is great, but the actual physical product is not shown within the first 3 seconds.

speech_audit.pacing_evaluation: Background music only; voiceover is completely missing.

safe_zone_violations: Text elements ('An online assessment to fix it all') slightly infringe upon the top platform UI safe zone on Instagram Reels.

creative_audit.revision_message: Hi there! Great work on the clean animation style and engaging flow. However, we have a few critical updates needed before this can go live: 1) The promo code 'TRAYA20' and brand name 'Traya Health' need to be spoken out loud in a voiceover. 2) Please ensure the physical product box/bottles appear clearly within the first 3 seconds as part of the hook. 3) Kindly check the safe zones so text elements don't get covered by UI icons. Let us know if you have any questions!

ad_name: Pilgrim - 24K Gold Face Serum Campaign Ad

safe_zone_violations: On-screen text elements at the bottom appear in the TikTok/Reels caption overlap danger zone during the lower-third title sequences.

creative_audit.revision_message: Hey! Fantastic job on the visual aesthetics, lighting, and premium glow vibe. Let me know if you can get these quick tweaks over to us!
